Which word belongs to this topic?
Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

office — a room where people work. Example: I work in an office.
hospital — a place where ill people are treated. Example: My mother works in a hospital.
school — a place where children learn. Example: My sister works at a school.
company — a business that sells things. Example: She works in a big company.
factory — a building where goods are made. Example: My father works in a factory.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Where do you work?
• I work in a ...
• She works at a ...
• It is a big company.
• It is near the station.

Which word carries the main stress?
Grammar focus: Present Simple for work routines.
Use in or at with workplaces: She works in a hospital. He works at a school. A company can be big or small.

Reading: read the text and answer the questions.
My mother works in a hospital and my father works in a factory. My sister works at a school and my friend works in a big company. I work in an office.
Listening: listen to the dialogue and answer the questions.
A: Where do you work? B: In an office in the city. A: And your wife? B: She works at a school.
